## durin profiles list --config-dir <TMP>/open
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
The Durin directory <TMP>/open must be a directory owned by you that only you can access. Run chmod 700 on it, or choose another --config-dir.

<TMP>/shared, on the path to the Durin configuration directory, is world-writable without the sticky bit, so another user could replace it. Choose another --config-dir.
